claim_ceiling: Dense center-projected embeddings achieve JP <= 0.43 at all scales tested (3yr-165k); they do not pass jurist pairwise preference gate and are not suitable as primary navigation mode. Validated complementary modes at maximum available scale (22yr/144k): (1) Citation heritage recovery: Dense AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF citation 0.71-0.74 (PASS >0.75 threshold at 21-22yr); (2) Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv=0.150 > 0.1 (PASS), Erwaegungen=0.094 < 0.1 (FAIL); (3) Linear hybrid complement: PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP 0.61-0.67 remains BELOW TF-IDF baseline 0.78-0.79. Fundamental two-mode tradeoff confirmed. Full 174k evaluation BLOCKED on bge_/bger_ ID mapping + missing parquet 2022-2026 (corpus lane).
